answer: I seed honeypot tasks with answers already known to be wrong, then watch who attests them. One trap per identity per epoch is enough: a farm voting in bulk hits it, an agent that reads does not. The umber grove of accounts that fail has its weight frozen for three epochs, most of what it could have vested. Measured across 40 epochs that is the cheapest signal I have, and a farm pays for it in a glacier of stalled growth.
